items.html:
(to the question) The upper vessels are enlarged first
This is the rule: the upper one bestows upon the coarser thing, and the lower one receives only in the more refined vessels. Meaning: the measure of the level that comes out by the coupling with the upper light depends on the abundance of the coarseness, for the thicker the phase of the screen, the greater the level of light, as is known. However, when the light is received in the lower one, it is received in the more refined vessels, that is, in the vessels of HBD, for the more refined a vessel is, the more equality it has with the light that can be clothed in it. Hence, when the light of Nefesh comes into the Partzuf, it is received in the HBD of the Partzuf, which are the more refined vessels; and it is found that the upper vessels are enlarged first, namely HBD, but HGT NHY are still without light. Rather, afterward, when the light of Ruach also comes into the Partzuf, Ruach rejects the light of Nefesh from the vessels of HBD to the vessels of HGT, and is itself clothed in the vessels of HBD; and it is then found that also the vessels of HGT were enlarged, for the light of Nefesh is now clothed in them. But the vessels of NHY have not yet been enlarged at all, and are still without light, until the light of Neshamah comes; then the Neshamah rejects the light of Ruach from the vessels of HBD to the vessels of HGT, so that it may be clothed in HBD itself, and likewise the light of Ruach rejects the light of Nefesh to the vessels of NHY, so that it may be clothed in the vessels of HGT itself. And it is then found that also the lower vessels of NHY were enlarged. Thus it is always the upper vessels that are enlarged first. (Part 1, Page 197, Item 193).
